M3 — live Supabase (tarmpqxsabbehgjaonfz), 27 Aug 2026, BEFORE apply

Branch declined on cost ($0.01344/hour, checked against the real org),
reaffirmed after seeing the figure, and M3 instructed to proceed to live
anyway. So the branch matrix is replaced by a REAL before/after against live,
using the M1 discipline: baseline and prediction first, verify after.

════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ONE THING STEP 1 COULD NOT DO, AND WHY

`counsellors` and `bookings.counsellor_id` DO NOT EXIST until M3 creates them.
So Karabo and Nicola cannot be seeded as counsellors BEFORE the apply — there
is nowhere to put them and no column to attach a booking to.

That is not effort I skipped; it is the thing being measured not existing yet.
Their accounts DO already exist in auth.users, so they are probed here as
themselves — and read nothing, correctly, because they hold no role.

The counsellor-vs-counsellor rows become measurable only AFTER the apply and
are reported separately, clearly labelled.

TWO PROBE ROWS were seeded to make the "before" real rather than theoretical:

  0e3b0000-...-a1  and  0e3b0000-...-a2
  service = 'M3 PROBE — delete after verification'
  service_line = 'psychosocial'
  owner = 2358cfbf-621a-4009-b4ba-9a138d53de8d (a Test Co member, deliberately
          NOT Karabo or Nicola, who are both themselves Test Co members and
          would have confounded the result by reading their own rows)

They are DELETED after verification.

════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
THE BEFORE MATRIX — measured, not remembered

  persona                          financial   psychosocial
  France (admin + lead + HR)            22           2
  Lone (admin + psychosocial)           22           2
  Michelle (admin + psychosocial)       22           2
  Advisor, plain                         0           0
  HR only                                0           0
  Karabo (no counsellor role yet)        0           0
  Nicola (no counsellor role yet)        0           0

  Test Co Q3 total_booked, which HR READS   : 10
  bookings policies                          : 9
  kw_can_see_booking exists                  : no
  RLS enabled on bookings                    : true

FOUR THINGS THIS BEFORE-MATRIX SHOWS THAT PROSE WOULD HAVE GOT WRONG

1. FRANCE IS THE TEAM LEAD, THE ADMIN AND AN HR ACCOUNT, ALL THREE. Three rows
   of the intended matrix collapse into one person on this database. His single
   row therefore carries both the "France-type admin" assertion and the
   "financial team lead" assertion.

2. THERE IS NO NON-ADMIN TEAM LEAD ON LIVE to test separately. The team-lead
   path is exercised through France or not at all.

3. THE PLAIN ADVISOR READS 0 FINANCIAL, not 22. Not because a policy denies
   them — because only 2 of 5 advisors carry a user_id, so
   current_advisor_id() does not resolve for them. Their 0 is an identity
   failure wearing the costume of an access decision, and it means the advisor
   row of this matrix proves nothing either way. Recorded rather than papered
   over.

4. THE PROBE ROWS ARE ALREADY IN HR's NUMBER. Test Co total_booked reads 10;
   it read 8 before they were seeded. That is section 8.1 of the plan happening
   in front of us: psychosocial sessions land in HR's session totals silently,
   with no decision having been taken.

THE PREDICTION — written BEFORE applying

  persona                        financial          psychosocial
  France                         22 -> 22           2 -> 0   <- the migration
  Lone                           22 -> 22           2 -> 2
  Michelle                       22 -> 22           2 -> 2
  Advisor, plain                  0 ->  0           0 -> 0
  HR only                         0 ->  0           0 -> 0
  Karabo                          0 ->  0           0 -> 0
  Nicola                          0 ->  0           0 -> 0

  Test Co Q3 total_booked        10 -> 8    (the two psychosocial rows leave
                                             HR's figure — section 8.1)
  bookings policies               9 -> 11
  kw_can_see_booking exists      no -> yes
  RLS on bookings               true -> true

  In plain language, the two changes this migration exists for:

    France · psychosocial · SELECT : 0 rows (was: all rows)
    HR     · psychosocial · counted: not counted (was: counted in total_booked)

  And the two that must NOT change:

    France · financial · SELECT : 22 rows (was: 22 rows)
    Lone   · psychosocial · SELECT : 2 rows (was: 2 rows)

AFTER THE APPLY, separately, once counsellors can exist:

    Karabo · her own psychosocial booking     : 1 row
    Karabo · Nicola's psychosocial booking    : 0 rows
    Nicola · her own psychosocial booking     : 1 row
    Nicola · Karabo's psychosocial booking    : 0 rows
    Karabo · financial                        : 0 rows
    Lone   · counselling notes                : 0 rows

IF ANYTHING DOES NOT MATCH: stop, report, change nothing further.
